name: @eveshipfit/data
description: Local stub for @eveshipfit/react's only import from @eveshipfit/data — the ESF_DATA_VERSION constant it uses to build its default data URL, which edencom-link overrides via <EveDataProvider dataUrl="/esf-data/">. Replaces the multi-MB, monthly-republished GitHub Packages @eveshipfit/data so `pnpm install` needs no read:packages token. See src/buildEsfData.js for how the actual .pb2 data is generated locally from CCP's SDE.
